dct_title_s: Satellite-Detected Newly Formed Barrier Lakes Following an Ice-Rock Avalanche in Rasuwa District, Nepal, as of 28 August 2026
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20260826NPL, GDACS ID: 1104124** This map illustrates two newly formed barrier lakes detected from CARTOSAT-3 imagery acquired on 28 August 2026. The first barrier lake, with an estimated area of approximately 12 ha, is located near the Nepal–China border, approximately 11 km east of the Rasuwagadhi Friendship Bridge, measured along the Chusumdo Tsangpo River and following the approximate mudflow/rockflow path. The second barrier lake, with an estimated area of approximately 19 ha, is located approximately 2 km west of the potential ice-rock avalanche source area, with the source area situated further east along the river channel. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
